author: DaBomb94
body:
Current IGN: DaBomb94
Reason Banned: Inappropriate links
Banned on: February 16, 2015 12:09:55 PM GMT
Banned by: ThePizza (Diamond)

I think I should be banned because when I made these links I was very childish and stupid. Also, I was very jokey, when I said what I did I was just joking around. This was a mistake as some people can take jokes very seriously. Ever since my ban I have had a chance to grow up and I know when is the right time and place to make a joke and not to take jokes and links too far. I have also been banned for a long time now. I think I have served my ban for long enough.

This is why I think I deserve to be unbanned, thank you for reading my appeal.

DaBomb94

replies.author: Gundham
replies.body:
Greetings, DaBomb94.

Given you've waited a bit more than ten months after your punishment, and haven't attempted ban evasion to escape your punishment, I will be appealing your infraction.

Make sure to abide by our ruleset this time, and you won't experience any complications.

That being said, welcome back to the server and have fun.

Sincerely,
- Vinnx | Senior Moderator
